translation.name: Suha' Maseho: Kadadiam anna Pa'dandiam Bakahu

content: Pessubunna Adam
Wattunna anna untampai hupatau Puang Allataala, natampa susi kalena. Napapia dua hupa: muane anna baine. Puhai natampa, natamba'um anna nasangai “Hupatau”. Iya indem pessubunna Adam:
Tappana sahatu' tallu puloi taunna dadinna Adam, iya undadiammi mesa muane nasangai Set. Indo Set bangom kaju ambena.
Puhai undadiam Set, tubopi kahua hatu' taunna Adam anna undadiam polepi sanaka-naka änä', muane anna baine.
Ia ham mane matei kaseha hatu' tallu pulo taunna.
Tappana sahatu' limai taunna dadinna Set, undadiammi mesa muane nasangai Enos.
Puhai undadiam Enos, tubopi kahua hatu' pitu taunna Set anna undadiam polepi sanaka-naka änä', muane anna baine.
Ia ham mane matei kaseha hatu' sapulo dua taunna.
Tappana kaseha puloi taunna dadinna Enos, undadiammi mesa muane, nasangai Kenan.
Puhai undadiam Kenan, tubopi kahua hatu' sapulo lima taunna Enos anna undadiam polepi sanaka-naka änä', muane anna baine.
Ia ham mane matei kaseha hatu' lima taunna.
Tappana pitu puloi taunna dadinna Kenan, undadiammi mesa muane, nasangai Mahalaleel.
Puhai undadiam Mahalaleel, tubopi kahua hatu' appa' pulo taunna Kenan anna undadiam polepi sanaka-naka änä', muane anna baine.
Ia ham mane matei, tappana kaseha hatu' sapulo taunna.
Tappana annam pulo limai taunna dadinna Mahalaleel, undadiammi mesa muane, nasangai Yared.
Puhai undadiam Yared, tubopi kahua hatu' tallu pulo taunna Mahalaleel anna undadiam polepi sanaka-naka änä', muane anna baine.
Ia ham mane matei kahua hatu' kaseha pulo lima taunna.
Tappana sahatu' annam pulo dua taunna dadinna Yared, undadiammi mesa muane nasangai Henokh.
Puhai undadiam Henokh tubopi kahua hatu' taunna Yared anna undadiam polepi sanaka-naka änä', muane anna baine.
Ia ham mane matei kaseha hatu' annam pulo dua taunna.
Tappana annam pulo lima taunna dadinna Henokh, undadiammi mesa muane nasangai Metusalah.
Puhai undadiam Metusalah, tubopi tallu hatu' taunna Henokh silombum Puang Allataala anna natuhu'i pa'elo'na. Anna undadiam polepi sanaka-naka änä', muane anna baine.
Dadi tallu hatu' annam pulo taunna naolaam tubo Henokh silombum liu Puang Allataala mane tä'i deem diita pole aka naäkä'um Puang Allataala längäm suhuga.
Tappana sahatu' kahua pulo pitu taunna dadinna Metusalah, undadiammi mesa muane nasangai Lamekh.
Puhai undadiam Lamekh, tubopi pitu hatu' kahua pulo dua taunna Metusalah anna undadiam polepi sanaka-naka änä', muane anna baine.
Ia ham mane matei kaseha hatu' annam pulo kaseha taunna.
Tappana sahatu' kahua pulo dua taunna dadinna Lamekh, undadiammi mesa muane
nasangai Nuh
aka naua: “Inde änä' la mebabaam pepakahangaam illaam pengkähänganta indo taongei madahha muasai pala'ta ungkähä inde litä' puha natädo DEBATA.”
Puhai undadiam Nuh, tubopi lima hatu' kaseha pulo lima taunna Lamekh anna undadiam polepi sanaka-naka änä', muane anna baine.
Ia ham mane matei pitu hatu' pitu pulo pitu taunna.
Tappana lima hatu' taunna dadinna Nuh, undadiammi tallu muane anna nasangai Sem, Ham, anna Yafet.
